item: Sink sweep 5/n slice 3: the records guard reads src/database
summary: The strict records guard now reads src/database (repair.py joins with the WAL thread's PR): the damage lane's classifiers and walks are counted line by line, the stored records were already class-only by design (failure_label/failure_text/corruption_of), so no stored text changed; the segmenter fallback word reads cleanly. Also: the fetcher refuses a URL that urlparse and urllib3 read as two hosts (backslash, whitespace, control characters) before every request, first and each redirect hop (tests/test_ssrf_parser_mismatch.py).
